string.text: Russian-made semi-automatic pistol, developed in the 1990s to replace PM, which by that time was becoming obsolete. Key advantages are very small weight of the firearm and high-capacity magazine. Low position of the barrel relative to the shooter's hands and excellent weight distribution allows for accurate and tightly-grouped fire. Mass production started in 2001 and the firearm is used as self-defense weapon in various Russian law enforcement agencies and the military.
